svg.aria-label: Side by side data flow of the first, KZG-based design and the proposed hash-based design through encoding, proof generation, per-column verification and sampling, with measured times for a 1 MiB blob
svg.text: Executor: encode and produce proofs
DA node, subnetwork j: verify, store, serve
Validator or light client: sample
First design (spec 148): BLS12-381, KZG row commitments, FK20 column proofs
1 MiB blob, 33 rows × 1 024 chunks of 31 B, 1 thread
1. rows → polynomials f_i, RS-extend to 2 048 columns
interpolate + NTT per row · 16 ms
2. row commitments com_i = KZG(f_i), 33 MSMs of 1 024 points
784 ms · needs SRS (trusted setup)
3. h = BLAKE2b(com_1 ‖ … ‖ com_33), f_C = Σ h^i f_i
field ops only · < 1 ms
4. proof generation: FK20 opens f_C at all 2 048 columns
three G1 FFTs of size 4 096 · 7 384 ms, independent of blob size
on chain: hash of (com_1 … com_33)
encode total 8 183 ms (2 486 ms on 8 cores)
disperse
2.6 KiB
receives per blob
column j: 33 chunks, 1 023 B
proof π_j: 48 B
com_1 … com_33: 1.5 KiB
verifies
com_C = Σ h^i com_i (MSM of 33), v_j = Σ h^i data_i^j
pairing check e(π_j, …) · 3.6 ms per column
replicates the same 2.6 KiB to 4 peers
serves column + π_j on request; no computation
serve
1.07 KiB
once per blob
fetch com_1 … com_33 (1.5 KiB), check hash against chain
per sampled column, S = 20 per round
column + π_j (1.07 KiB)
same MSM + pairing as the DA node · 3.6 ms
per blob: 23 KiB, 72 ms of verification
guarantee: KZG binding (discrete log) →
a column that verifies belongs to a unique blob
Recommended design: Goldilocks, BLAKE2b Merkle root over columns, published check row
1 MiB blob, 128 rows × 1 024 chunks of 8 B, 1 thread
1. rows RS-extended to 2 048 columns, NTT over Goldilocks
4.3 ms
2. hash each column, Merkle tree → root R_cols
2 048 BLAKE2b + 2 047 node hashes · 3.1 ms
3. h = H(R_cols) in F_p², check row c_j = Σ h^i data_i^j
128 × 2 048 mult-adds · 0.6 ms · c is itself an RS codeword
4. proof generation: none
proof_j = Merkle path of column j (11 hashes) + c_j, read from memory
on chain: R_cols ‖ H(c), 64 B · no trusted setup
encode total 8 ms (33 ms at 4 MiB)
disperse
1.7 KiB
receives per blob
column j: 128 chunks, 1 024 B
Merkle path: 11 × 32 B = 352 B
c_j (16 B) + path in the check-row tree (352 B)
verifies
path → R_cols, then Σ h^i data_i^j = c_j
12 hashes + 256 field mults · 3.8 µs per column
replicates the same 1.7 KiB to 4 peers
serves column + paths + c_j; no codeword check needed here
serve
1.4 KiB
once per blob
fetch check row c (32 KiB), check H(c) against chain,
check c is an RS codeword: one 2 048-point iNTT · 0.09 ms
per sampled column, S = 20 per round
column + path + c_j (1.4 KiB) · same check as the DA node · 3.8 µs
per blob: 59 KiB, 0.2 ms of verification
guarantee: once S random columns of its own agree with c,
a column that matches c belongs to a unique blob, error ≈ (3/4)^S per validator
